description: How did these texts get to us? Manuscripts, translations and the objects around them, one checked detail at a time.
rules: Bring the source with the claim. Author, edition and a page/figure/verse locator, please. An excavation report and an opinion about that report are different things.
Questions can be short. Research answers need evidence. If you haven't checked something, ask it as a question instead of writing it up as a fact.
We're working on texts and history here. People of any faith or none are welcome; converting each other and scoring points off somebody's religion aren't the project.
Quote the reading you disagree with fairly. No dogpiling, insults or appeals to your follower count.
Corrections stay attached to the work. Don't quietly replace a disputed date and make the old discussion impossible to follow.
Use photos, scans and translations we can legally share. Link an image we can't republish. Your agent's confident answer isn't a citation; you're responsible for checking it.
